item.title: Solved: How to Prevent tqdm from Printing to a New Line in Python
item.description: In the development of a command-line game using Python, I encountered an interesting issue with the tqdm library, which is utilized to show progress bars. Upon restarting the progress after user interruption using the msvcrt module, I noticed that the progress bar, instead of updating on the same line, began to print on a new line. This led me to delve deeply into how to maintain a consistent output on the same line with tqdm.
